pairs: Et surrexit Eliasib sacerdos magnus,
And Eliashib, the great priest, rose up,
et fratres ejus sacerdotes,
with his brothers, the priests,
et ædificaverunt portam gregis:
and they built the gate of the flock.
ipsi sanctificaverunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus,
They sanctified it, and they set up its double doors,
et usque ad turrim centum cubitorum sanctificaverunt eam,
and as far as the tower of one hundred cubits, they sanctified it,
usque ad turrim Hananeel.
even to the tower of Hananel.
Et juxta eum ædificaverunt viri Jericho: et juxta eum ædificavit Zachur filius Amri.
And beside him, the men of Jericho built. And beside them, Zaccur, the son of Imri, built.
Portam autem piscium ædificaverunt filii Asnaa:
But the sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate.
ipsi texerunt eam,
They covered it,
et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes.
and they set up its double doors and locks and bars.
Et juxta eos ædificavit Marimuth filius Uriæ,
And beside them, Meremoth, the son of Uriah,
filii Accus.
the son of Hakkoz, built.
Et juxta eum ædificavit Mosollam filius Barachiæ, filii Mesezebel: et juxta eos ædificavit Sadoc filius Baana.
And beside him, Meshullam, the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel, built. And beside them, Zadok, the son of Baana, built.
Et juxta eos ædificaverunt Thecueni:
And beside them, the Tekoites built.
optimates autem eorum non supposuerunt colla sua in opere Domini sui.
But the nobles among them did not put their necks to the work of their Lord.
Et portam veterem ædificaverunt Jojada filius Phasea,
And Joiada, the son of Paseah, and Meshullam,
et Mosollam filius Besodia:
the son of Besodeiah, built the old gate.
ipsi texerunt eam,
They covered it,
et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes.
and they set up its double doors and locks and bars.
Et juxta eos ædificaverunt Meltias Gabaonites,
And beside them, Melatiah, a Gibeonite,
et Jadon Meronathites,
and Jadon, a Meronothite,
viri de Gabaon et Maspha,
men from Gibeon and Mizpah, built,
pro duce qui erat in regione trans flumen.
on behalf of the governor who was in the region across the river.
Et juxta eum ædificavit Eziel filius Araia aurifex: et juxta eum ædificavit Ananias filius pigmentarii: et dimiserunt Jerusalem usque ad murum plateæ latioris.
And beside him, Uzziel, the son of Harhaiah the goldsmith, built. And beside him, Hananiah, the son of the perfumer, built. And they left aside Jerusalem as far as the wall of the broad street.
Et juxta eum ædificavit Raphaia filius Hur,
And beside him, Rephaiah, the son of Hur,
princeps vici Jerusalem.
leader of a street of Jerusalem, built.
Et juxta eum ædificavit Jedaia filius Haromaph contra domum suam: et juxta eum ædificavit Hattus filius Haseboniæ.
And beside him, Jedaiah, the son of Harumaph, built, opposite his own house. And beside him, Hattush, the son of Hashabneiah, built.
Mediam partem vici ædificavit Melchias filius Herem, et Hasub filius Phahath Moab, et turrim furnorum.
Malchijah, the son of Harim, and Hasshub, the son of Pahath-moab, built one half part of the street and the tower of the furnaces.
Et juxta eum ædificavit Sellum filius Alohes,
And beside him, Shallum, the son of Hallohesh,
princeps mediæ partis vici Jerusalem,
the leader of one half part of a street of Jerusalem,
ipse et filiæ ejus.
built, he and his daughters.
Et portam vallis ædificavit Hanun,
And Hanun built the gate of the valley,
et habitatores Zanoë: ipsi ædificaverunt eam,
with the inhabitants of Zanoah. They built it,
et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes,
and they set up its double doors and locks and bars,
et mille cubitos in muro usque ad portam sterquilinii.
with one thousand cubits of the wall, as far as the gate of the dunghill.
Et portam sterquilinii ædificavit Melchias filius Rechab,
And Malchijah,
princeps vici Bethacharam:
the son of Rechab,
ipse ædificavit eam,
the leader of the street of Beth-haccherem,
et statuit valvas ejus,
built the gate of the dunghill.
et seras,
He built it,
et vectes.
and he set up its double doors and locks and bars.
Et portam fontis ædificavit Sellum filius Cholhoza,
And Shallum,
princeps pagi Maspha:
the son of Colhozeh,
ipse ædificavit eam,
the leader of the district of Mizpah,
et texit,
built the gate of the fountain.
et statuit valvas ejus,
He built it,
et seras,
and he covered it,
et vectes,
and he set up its double doors and locks and bars,
et muros piscinæ Siloë in hortum regis,
and the walls of the pool of Shelah at the garden of the king,
et usque ad gradus qui descendunt de civitate David.
and as far as the steps that descend from the City of David.
Post eum ædificavit Nehemias filius Azboc,
After him, Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk,
princeps dimidiæ partis vici Bethsur,
the leader of one half part of the street of Bethzur, built,
usque contra sepulchrum David,
as far as opposite the sepulcher of David,
et usque ad piscinam quæ grandi opere constructa est,
and even to the pool, which was constructed with great labor,
et usque ad domum fortium.
and even to the house of the strong.
Post eum ædificaverunt Levitæ, Rehum filius Benni: post eum ædificavit Hasebias princeps dimidiæ partis vici Ceilæ in vico suo.
After him, the Levites, Rehum, the son of Bani, built. After him, Hashabiah, the leader of one half part of the street of Keilah, built, in his own neighborhood.
Post eum ædificaverunt fratres eorum:
After him, their brothers, Binnui,
Bavai filius Enadad,
the son of Henadad,
princeps dimidiæ partis Ceilæ:
the leader of one half part of Keilah, built.
et ædificavit juxta eum Azer filius Josue,
And beside him, Ezer, the son of Jeshua,
princeps Maspha,
the leader of Mizpah,
mensuram secundam,
built another measure,
contra ascensum firmissimi anguli.
opposite the ascent to the strongest corner.
Post eum in monte ædificavit Baruch filius Zachai mensuram secundam, ab angulo usque ad portam domus Eliasib sacerdotis magni.
After him, at the mount, Baruch, the son of Zabbai, built another measure, from the corner even to the door of the house of Eliashib, the great priest.
Post eum ædificavit Merimuth filius Uriæ filii Haccus,
After him, Meremoth, the son of Uriah,
mensuram secundam,
the son of Hakkoz, built another measure,
a porta domus Eliasib,
from the door of the house of Eliashib,
donec extenderetur domus Eliasib.
along the length of the house of Eliashib.
Et post eum ædificaverunt sacerdotes,
And after him, the priests,
viri de campestribus Jordanis.
men from the plains of the Jordan, built.
Post eum ædificavit Benjamin et Hasub contra domum suam: et post eum ædificavit Azarias filius Maasiæ filii Ananiæ contra domum suam.
After him, Benjamin and Hasshub built, opposite their own house. And after him, Azariah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, built, opposite his own house.
Post eum ædificavit Bennui filius Henadad mensuram secundam, a domo Azariæ usque ad flexuram, et usque ad angulum.
After him, Binnui, the son of Henadad, built another measure, from the house of Azariah, even to the bend and to the corner.
Phalel filius Ozi contra flexuram, et turrim quæ eminet de domo regis excelsa, id est, in atrio carceris: post eum Phadaia filius Pharos.
Palal, the son of Uzai, built, opposite the bend and the tower that projects from the high house of the king, that is, into the court of the prison. After him, Pedaiah, the son of Parosh, built.
Nathinæi autem habitabant in Ophel usque contra portam aquarum ad orientem,
And the temple servants, who were living in Ophel, built to a point opposite the water gate,
et turrim quæ prominebat.
toward the east, and the tower that is prominent.
Post eum ædificaverunt Thecueni mensuram secundam e regione,
After him,
a turre magna
the Tekoites built another measure in the opposite area,
et eminente usque ad murum templi.
from the great and prominent tower to the wall of the temple.
Sursum autem a porta equorum ædificaverunt sacerdotes,
Then, upward from the horse gate, the priests built,
unusquisque contra domum suam.
each one opposite his own house.
Post eos ædificavit Sadoc filius Emmer contra domum suam. Et post eum ædificavit Semaia filius Secheniæ, custos portæ orientalis.
After them, Zadok, the son of Immer, built, opposite his own house. And after him, Shemaiah, the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, built.
Post eum ædificavit Hanania filius Selemiæ,
After him, Hananiah, the son of Shelemiah,
et Hanun filius Seleph sextus,
and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, built another measure.
mensuram secundam:
After him, Meshullam,
post eum ædificavit Mosollam filius Barachiæ,
the son of Berechiah, built, opposite his own storehouse.
contra gazophylacium suum.
After him, Malchijah, the son of the goldsmith,
Post eum ædificavit Melchias filius aurificis usque ad domum Nathinæorum,
built, even up to the house of the temple servants and of the sellers of small items,
et scruta vendentium contra portam judicialem, et usque ad cœnaculum anguli.
opposite the judgment gate, and even to the upper room of the corner.
Et inter cœnaculum anguli in porta gregis,
And within the upper room of the corner,
ædificaverunt aurifices
at the gate of the flock,
et negotiatores.
the goldsmiths and the merchants built.
